rfc: §15.2 (F1 payload enum Relevance: RELEVANT, IRRELEVANT, UNMEASURABLE; §24 capability levels)

measurement.line-addressable: a .py artefact: executable lines of its own code objects, required capability line-coverage
measurement.non-line-addressable: any other artefact: artefact-access (the case opened it), no line approximation
measurement.branch: branch-coverage arcs from a changed executable line, recorded as stronger evidence, never required
measurement.runner: the harness-owned unittest runner under --measure: sys.settrace + threading.settrace + an open() audit hook, per case; it declares FULL, PARTIAL (a case replaced the tracer) or UNAVAILABLE (no --measure); the pytest adapter declares nothing
